children: Ramada by Wyndham Ghaziabad Vasundhara has appointed Remank Goel as Hotel Manager, bringing over 15 years of hospitality experience across sales, business development, revenue generation and commercial leadership. In his new role, Goel will oversee the hotel’s day-to-day operations, with a focus on guest experience, operational efficiency, financial performance, revenue growth and market positioning.
He will also work closely with the hotel’s teams and stakeholders to strengthen business across corporate, leisure, MICE and social segments.

Goel joins from Lemon Tree Hotels, where he served as Cluster Director of Sales – Gurugram, overseeing business across nine operating hotels. Previously, he was Director of Sales & Marketing at Crowne Plaza Greater Noida, leading commercial strategy, revenue generation, corporate and MICE business, and sales and marketing initiatives.

His career includes senior roles with IHG Hotels & Resorts, Lemon Tree Hotels, Sarovar Hotels & Resorts and The Lalit Suri Hospitality Group, as well as experience in corporate travel with FCM Travel Solutions India. He holds a PGDBM in Sales & Marketing from IMT Ghaziabad and a qualification in Hospitality Administration and Management from JPIHM.

“We are pleased to welcome Remank to Ramada by Wyndham Ghaziabad Vasundhara. His experience across different areas of hospitality, along with his strong understanding of the Delhi-NCR market, will be valuable to the property. We look forward to his leadership as we continue to focus on our guests, our people and the overall performance of the hotel.” said,
